t: Health situation in Russia’s Irkutsk Region remains stable — health watchdog
d: Earlier, rumors circulated online that an employee of an anti-plague institute in the Irkutsk Region had allegedly been diagnosed with plague. The information was not confirmed

t: ARVI incidence in Irkutsk Region 12.6% below epidemic threshold — watchdog
d: According to the report, the incidence rate corresponds to long-term averages

t: Irkutsk Region records about 16,000 ARVI cases weekly
d: There was no upward trend in case numbers over the past 14 days
